purpose: Claudestra maintenance fork of codex-acp: where this tree came from and every local change on top of it.

localPatches.summary: Tests that start the real Codex binary skip when CODEX_ACP_SKIP_BINARY_TESTS=1. In CodexAcpClient.test.ts they are marked itWithBinary and the shared real-Codex fixture in beforeEach is then not started, so its other 95 tests (mock-only) run without the binary; mcp-session and mcp-config-merge are binary-only and skip as whole suites. No effect when the variable is unset.
localPatches.reason: The local gate does not install @openai/codex (333 MB). Without this patch it had to exclude CodexAcpClient.test.ts as a whole and lost its mock-only regression tests (auth, resume, compaction, goals, cancellation). The skipped binary tests are listed in build/binary-tests.json.
